definition: In a biological or mental health context, systemic means relating to the body as a whole rather than to one single organ or local area. In this packet, it refers to overall inflammatory status reflected by a blood-based index.

reasons: The packet supports only the phrase "systemic inflammatory status" in the context of the systemic immune-inflammation index; it does not support the broader dictionary claim that "systemic" means relating to the body as a whole rather than to a single organ or local area.
The definition adds an extra sense claim about a "mental health context" that is not supported by the packet.

The packet does not explicitly support the first sentence’s general meaning of “systemic” as “relating to the body as a whole rather than to one single organ or local area.” It only describes “systemic inflammatory status” in relation to the “systemic immune-inflammation index (SII).”

The second sentence is partially supported: the packet states that SII “reflects systemic inflammatory status” and is “derived from peripheral blood counts,” but the definition’s broad biological-generalization in sentence 1 is unsupported.
